privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.draftNotice: Draft pending legal review by PaoClean.

sections.title: Who is responsible for your data
sections.body: PaoClean, based in Miami, Florida, is responsible for the personal information you share with us through this website.

sections.title: What we collect
sections.body: Your name, phone number, the service you're interested in and, if you provide them, your preferred appointment date and time, when you fill out the form or contact us by WhatsApp, phone or email.

sections.title: How we use it
sections.body: Only to answer your request, send you a quote and schedule the service. We do not sell or rent your information.

sections.title: Messages and calls
sections.body: By submitting the form, you allow us to contact you by phone, text message or WhatsApp about your request. You can ask us to stop contacting you at any time.

sections.title: Who we share it with
sections.body: Only with the services we use to receive and organize requests and appointments, such as our email, scheduling or customer management provider, and when required by law.

sections.title: Your rights
sections.body: You can ask us to access, correct or delete your information by emailing us. We will reply within a reasonable time.

sections.title: Contact
sections.body: For any questions about this policy, email us at the address shown at the bottom of this page.
